summary: Engineering plan for redesigning the Commit Detail Overview modal to match the user-provided reference screenshot (Screenshot_20261108_115256.jpg). Includes header layout, segmented tab pills, Message card with copy button, Metadata key-value table (Author avatar badge, formatted Committed Date, monospaced Full SHA with copy, clickable Parent Commit pill), and the 2x2 bottom action grid (Restore, high-contrast white Branch, Copy SHA, Tag) with preservation of Delete HEAD and creation dialogs.
